title: Demo Income Support Scheme Guidelines 2025 (FICTIONAL)
sample_text:
CIVICLENS DEMO KNOWLEDGE SOURCE — FICTIONAL CONTENT FOR TESTING ONLY.

Section 1: Overview
The Demo Income Support Scheme provides direct financial benefit to eligible households residing within the state. The primary objective is to offer social security protection to low-income families.

Section 2: Eligibility Criteria
1. Annual Household Income: Must be less than or equal to ₹2,50,000 per annum as verified by an official Income Certificate.
2. Age Limit: Applicants must be 18 years of age or older on the date of application.
3. Residence: Must hold a valid Domicile / Residence Certificate of the state.

Section 3: Mandatory Documents
Applicants must submit:
a) Aadhaar Card / Identity Proof
b) State Income Certificate (issued within 1 year)
c) Residence Proof / Domicile Certificate
d) Bank Account Details for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
